name: FullRun sweep
message: Full search: 20,000,000 designs (random, out of 20,600,586,240) in 10 batches in 5.4 h · 1,201,664 pass · 3,167,214 fail a check · 15,631,122 unstable. Most common: outside the envelope (1,793,472 designs). Breakdown (a design can fail several): overlap 255,314, deflection 522,831, strength 745,017, envelope 1,793,472. The best-trade lines on the charts are exact; the grey cloud is a random 15,000 of the stable designs.
